description: Preserve Self-EvolveRec’s diagnostic interface while adapting its probes to the corrected BERT4Rec model. Return measured metrics with explicit definitions and generate an interpretation prompt grounded in those measurements.
motivation: Reliable diagnosis requires probes that match the trained architecture and available data. This adapter supports model improvement without inventing unavailable attributes or changing the benchmark selection criterion.
implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Access the actual trained network through view.model and preserve item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), and the host’s data interfaces. Handle left padding by locating the final nonpadding position rather than using count-1. Respect BERT4Rec’s reserved mask token, masked-target training, and appended-mask inference without target leakage. Use only public histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; treat unavailable review fields and simulator traits as unobserved. Produce full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for five real training users per category. Select models using macro validation HR@10 across all four categories. Maintain one independently trained checkpoint per category and consistent training and embedded prediction architectures.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe(view, device):
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state
        set view.model to evaluation mode
        with gradients disabled:
            for (_, sequence, positive, negative) in train_loader:
                identify valid tokens and masked targets using BERT4Rec conventions
                compute applicable probes through the preserved ModelView interfaces
                accumulate measurements with explicit denominators
        restore model training state
        return {metrics: measured_results, metric_definitions: definitions_and_availability}

diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
    return prompt containing measured metrics, definitions, availability limits,
           and instructions to distinguish observations from hypotheses

originality.positive: Connects architecture-aware diagnosis to a controlled recommendation benchmark.
originality.negative: Primarily an interface and measurement specification rather than a new learning algorithm.

future_potential.positive: Could support reproducible diagnosis and targeted improvements across sequential model architectures.
future_potential.negative: Predictive value depends on the chosen probes; no diagnostic results or validation gains are supplied.

code_difficulty.positive: The required interfaces and available data are clearly specified.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct masking, padding, metric aggregation, and predictor consistency require careful implementation.
